text:
jordan: RC5 cutover 16:30 UTC. PR #8129 (kv-cache-regen) needs 2x approvals before cutoff or we fall back to v2.3. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8129. Can folks pls triage? Need decision by then.
maria: looking now, what's the riskiest part?
jordan: main change is async KV warmup + mem reduce. Risk is cold-start regression under heavy prefix batching.
sam: tests are mostly green locally, but flaky e2e on long-context. pinging CI.
ci-bot: PR #8129 — checks: unit ✅, lint ✅, integration ⏳ (3 running), perf-suite started.
evan: can give LGTM if perf-suite shows no >5% latency regression. I can run baseline perf in ~15m.
lina: I can do a second review after evan; otherwise we should gate with feature-flag rollout and canary.
jordan: plan B: if not 2x LGTM, roll back PR and do a canary next cycle. We can also ship with feature-flag off. But cutoff is hard.
maria: quick ask: who can validate canary metrics within 1h after deploy? @ops oncall?
ops-bot: oncall is @sam_oncall for the next 12h.
sam: I can watch metrics. If perf shows <3% delta and errors unchanged, I'll sign off retrospectively.
evan: perf-suite finished — no reg over 2% on P95, looks fine. Posting snippet: ```p95 baseline:120ms -> 122ms (+1.7%)```
lina: looked at code, comments addressed, small nit fixed. LGTM
jordan: @lina thanks. @evan thanks. That's 2x LGTM. Cutting merge now. :rocket: 
ci-bot: merging PR #8129 — merge started, deploy pipeline queued.
ops-bot: starting canary rollout to 10% capacity.
sam: monitoring... will post update in 15m.
sam: canary stable, no anomalies, promoting to 100%.
